## Foot Soldier (CR 1/3)

**XP** 135  
Human warrior 1  
N Medium humanoid  
**Init** +1; **Senses** Perception +0  

**Defense**

 **AC** 16, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 armor, +1 Dex, +1 shield)  
**hp** 13 (1d10+3)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +1, **Will** +0  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** ranseur +3 (2d4+3/x3) or longsword +3 (1d8+2/19-20)  
**Ranged** musket +2 (1d12/x4)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft. (10 ft. with longspear)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 15, **Dex** 12, **Con** 11, **Int** 8, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 9  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 14  
**Feats** Step Up, Toughness  
**Skills** Craft (weapons) +3, Profession (soldier) +4, Survival +1  
**Languages** Common  
**Gear** light trooper armor, buckler, ranseur, longsword, musket with 5 metal cartridges.  

 **Boon** Foot soldiers can help PCs buy normal (nonmasterwork) simple or martial weapons costing less than 100 gp at a 10% discount or may agree to accompany the PCs as men-at-arms for a 10% share of the treasure.
